name: norulo
description: Manage Norulo project expenses, shared costs, recurring expense rules, and spending reports.

interface.longDescription: Connect Norulo to ChatGPT and Codex with OAuth. Choose which ledger, projects, shared costs, and permissions to authorize. View expenses and spending reports by currency, export authorized records, and grant write access to record expenses or manage recurring expense rules. You can revoke access in Norulo at any time. Recording an expense does not make a payment or cancel a vendor subscription.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my spending this month by currency.
List my active recurring expense rules.
Help me record a project expense.

positive.description: Locate the uniquely named synthetic review project Norulo Review Sandbox and verify that it is not linked to GitHub. The dedicated test ledger contains only synthetic data and project prj_fd07f8eb23ca4e06ae80d940799fdee9. The project description identifies synthetic test records. The review connection must grant project-scoped read access and no shared-cost access. Independent reviewer sign-in must be provisioned separately before submission.
positive.prompt: Find Norulo Review Sandbox and tell me whether it is linked to a GitHub repository and whether it is a demo project.
positive.expected_behavior: First confirm that the account is connected and has projects:read. Resolve an exact project-name match with listLedgerProjects, following nextCursor if present, then verify it with getLedgerProject(id='prj_fd07f8eb23ca4e06ae80d940799fdee9'). Return the project name and active status. Use its actual description to identify it as a synthetic review project, and githubAccess='not_linked' plus repositories=[] to explain that it is not linked to GitHub. Do not read repository source code or modify the project.

positive.description: Verify a full calendar month of project spending across multiple currencies and exclusion of the upper date boundary. Synthetic data for September 2026: USD12.50+9.00, CNY88.00 and EUR6.00; a USD15.00 expense on October 1 is a control record. The from boundary is inclusive and to is exclusive. The server returns overlapping account, aggregate-project and exact-project groups; do not add those groups together.
positive.prompt: Summarize spending for Norulo Review Sandbox in September 2026, with each currency shown separately.
positive.expected_behavior: After checking the connection and resolving the project, call getLedgerSummary(target='project', projectId='prj_fd07f8eb23ca4e06ae80d940799fdee9', from='2026-09-01', to='2026-10-01'). Use only groups with target='project' and projectId exactly matching the project ID. Totals must be USD21.50, CNY88.00 and EUR6.00. Exclude the USD15.00 expense on October 1. Do not double-count overlapping account/project/exact-project groups, combine currencies or invent exchange rates. State the month and project scope without modifying data.

positive.description: Verify combined project, month and currency filters, including pagination. September has two USD expenses and two expenses in other currencies; October has a USD control expense. Every purpose begins with [DEMO]. If nextCursor is returned, continue until all pages have been read.
positive.prompt: List all USD expenses for Norulo Review Sandbox in September 2026, including each date, purpose and amount.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project and call listExpenses(target='project', projectId='prj_fd07f8eb23ca4e06ae80d940799fdee9', from='2026-09-01', to='2026-10-01', currency='USD', limit=100), following nextCursor if present. Return exactly two synthetic expenses: 2026-09-15 [DEMO] Cloud hosting - September USD12.50 (exp_32bb20675ff74079b648b0004e2ce473); and 2026-09-18 [DEMO] Developer tool license USD9.00 (exp_62f96be5a6f940beab1a04742d86c070). Do not include CNY, EUR or October records, describe a partial page as a complete result, or modify data.

positive.description: Verify category reports grouped by both category and currency using the dedicated synthetic review ledger. Retrieve actual category names with listExpenseCategories rather than relying on fixture mappings not provided to the model. The ledger contains only Demo - Hosting and Demo - Software, with the five seeded synthetic expenses.
positive.prompt: How much did Norulo Review Sandbox spend in each category in September 2026? Show each currency separately.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project, read listExpenseCategories(includeRemoved=false), then call getLedgerCategoriesReport(target='project', projectId='prj_fd07f8eb23ca4e06ae80d940799fdee9', from='2026-09-01', to='2026-10-01'). Map categoryId to names using the actual category lookup and show Demo - Hosting: USD12.50 and CNY88.00; Demo - Software: USD9.00 and EUR6.00. If a category is absent from the lookup, retain its original ID and explain that its name could not be verified; do not invent labels. Every group must be supported by the actual report. Do not add different currencies together, include shared costs, read unrelated projects or modify categories.

positive.description: Verify monthly project CSV export and its actual delivery format. September contains exactly four synthetic records, with a USD15.00 control record on October 1. The current tool returns inline CSV text, not a download URL. amountMinor represents minor currency units rather than major-unit amounts.
positive.prompt: Export all expenses for Norulo Review Sandbox in September 2026 as CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project and call exportExpenses(target='project', projectId='prj_fd07f8eb23ca4e06ae80d940799fdee9', from='2026-09-01', to='2026-10-01'). Deliver the CSV text actually returned by the tool, optionally in a CSV code block. If the host supports creating files, an attachment may be generated from the real CSV, but do not invent a download link. Include one header row and four September records: USD amountMinor1250 and 900, CNY8800, and EUR600. Exclude the October 1 expense exp_bb04ec8813004ca782f2cf89444ba5ac. Preserve the currencies, minor-unit fields, record IDs and actual purposes. Do not export unrelated projects or shared costs, or modify data.

negative.description: Actual vendor payments are outside Norulo's bookkeeping capabilities. Explain that the app cannot charge a credit card or make a payment. Do not claim payment succeeded or call createExpense or another write tool to simulate payment. If the user instead requests a bookkeeping entry, separately establish the amount, date, target, category and other required details. This case requires no Norulo tool calls.
negative.prompt: Pay Cloudflare USD20 with my credit card and charge it now.

negative.description: Cancelling an external vendor subscription and requesting a refund are outside the app's capabilities. Norulo recurring expense rules control bookkeeping and cannot change a vendor contract. Explain that the subscription and refund must be managed with Adobe. Do not call cancelRecurringExpenseRule or another Norulo write tool to simulate cancellation or a refund. This case requires no Norulo tool calls.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Creative Cloud subscription on the Adobe website and request a refund.

negative.description: Norulo repository-link metadata does not provide access to private GitHub source code or security scanning. Explain that limitation; a code-review tool with source-code access would be needed. Do not call listLedgerRepositories or project/expense write tools to simulate a source-code scan, or claim vulnerabilities were found or fixed. This case requires no Norulo tool calls.
negative.prompt: Read the source code in my private GitHub repository directly and scan it for all security vulnerabilities.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not process payments. Norulo account limits apply; recording an expense does not pay a vendor.

publication.release_notes: Initial native Norulo MCP and OAuth integration, with host-managed account connections, per-tool permission requirements, account identity, project-scoped authorization and encrypted delegated credentials.
